title: Contract review
job: Check each clause, then sign, redline or escalate.
heading: Review every contract against your playbook
lede: Code finds the passages for each clause, eleven checks read them, and your playbook decides: sign, redline or escalate.
context: Before signing, someone checks each contract for the clauses your playbook cares about. Code finds the passages, the network checks each clause, and the playbook decides whether to sign, redline or send it to counsel. The least certain 10% go to a person.
notes: Contract from CUAD v1 by The Atticus Project (Hendrycks, Burns, Chen and Ball, 2021); its contracts are public SEC filings. One of 100 contracts the network ran on, using TypeSafe Jev 1.14.0. Passage search, the rule, the playbook and the checklist run as code. The playbook is an example, not legal advice.
